- If you prefer funds returned, we can initiate a wire refund for the net duplicated amount once Finance has verified; refunds typically take 3–7 business days after processing.

I'll open a HubSpot ticket and escalate to Finance for priority handling. If you need the credit applied immediately to the next invoice, indicate that and we’ll prioritize the credit memo route.

HubSpot ticket HS-33214.
